goal: Page 1 (top 10) for ten service-intent queries by 30 November 2026
why: Picked from the Search Console export in seo/gsc-baseline-2026-09-30.json, not from a wishlist. Every one of these already sits between position 10 and 26, which is one page of movement, on a page that already exists. Head terms like 'renovation companies dubai' (position 45-75, first page held by Clutch, Sortlist, MyBayut and agency listicles with years of backlinks behind them) are NOT in this list — they are a 2027 conversation, and putting them here would only make the target look met or missed for the wrong reasons.

milestones.test: weekly impressions back above 200 (they fell from 2307 to 18), and no target query worse than its 30 Sep position
at least 6 of the 10 inside the top 10, and the site taking real clicks again

measuredBy: The weekly autopilot runs these exact query strings and records where quvera.ae appears. A fresh Search Console export beats it on accuracy whenever one is available.

targets.query: interior design companies in emirates hills
interior design company in emirates hills
interior design companies in downtown dubai
interior design company in downtown dubai

notOnTrackUnless: Companies collect real reviews. Quvera ranks a directory page against the company's own site and its Google Business Profile; review count is the one signal a directory can win on, and most profiles have none.
Something links to quvera.ae. Nothing in this repo can create a backlink, and the pages holding position 1-10 for these queries all have them.
